app Invocations
Given
 Item { title:text }
 policy Item read=members
 contract References { local:invocation(mutate), optional:invocation(mutate)?, choices:invocation(empty,mutate), many:invocation(mutate)[], required:invocation(mutate)[]!, nullableMany:invocation(mutate)[]? }
When
 scenario mutate(record:Item, amount:decimal=1.50, note:text="default") by=members
  do
   let amountCopy = amount
 scenario descriptors(record:Item, amount:decimal=2.50, note:text="hello") read=true -> References by=members
  do
   return {local=invocation(arguments={note=note,amount=amount,record=record},target=mutate),optional=null,choices=invocation(empty,{}),many=[invocation(mutate,{record=record,amount=amount,note=note})],required=[],nullableMany=null}
 scenario empty() by=members
  do
   let value = 1
 scenario defaults() read=true -> invocation(empty) by=members
  do
   return invocation(empty,{})
Then
